statementAttestation.attribution: Codeforces, Tinkoff Challenge - Elimination Round, B. Igor and his way to work; public English statement mirrored by codeforces.me.
statementAttestation.extraction: Exact raw bytes from the opening problem-statement div through its balanced closing div; no HTML reserialization or text replacement.
statementAttestation.constraintsQuote: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 <= n, m <= 1000). Each of the next n lines contains m characters. S and T appear exactly once each.
statementAttestation.movementQuote: A turn is a change in movement direction. Igor's car can only move to the left, to the right, upwards and downwards. Initially Igor can choose any direction.
statementAttestation.outputQuote: In the only line print YES if there is a path between Igor's home and Igor's office with no more than two turns, and NO otherwise.
statementAttestation.quoteRendering: Quotes above are plain-text renderings, not byte quotations; exact original markup is bound by the statement SHA256.
statementAttestation.imageScope: The two omitted upstream note pictures illustrate the fully textual grid samples; they contain no missing problem definition. Their original URLs remain in the unchanged public statement copy.

statementNormalization.proposal: None. The upstream bound 1000 agrees with original English HTML; no power-of-ten inference or source correction is necessary.

semantics.input: 1<=n,m<=1000, exactly n physical rows of m characters from . * S T, one S and one T. n*m=1 has no legal instance because the endpoints are distinct cells. LF and CRLF are accepted without flattening rows; extra rows, characters or header tokens are rejected.
semantics.output: Unique uppercase YES or NO decision, no path construction, floating point, file IO, interaction or custom checker. Token comparison is appropriate.
semantics.oracle: A shortest feasible path can have collinear reversals/loops removed. A path with at most two genuine turns is HVH or VHV, with zero-length end segments covering straight and one-turn cases. Intersect the obstacle-bounded first/last straight intervals and test each possible middle segment. Checking every candidate costs at most O(n*m), with O(1) auxiliary oracle storage excluding the parsed rows.
semantics.smallReference: Separate BFS enumerates states (row,column,previous exact direction,turns) and walks one cell per edge; the initial direction costs no turn. Exhaust all obstacle masks for all ordered S/T pairs on 1x2,2x1,1x3,3x1,2x2,2x3,3x2,3x3: 10252 assertions. Add 500 independently seeded grids up to 8x8.
semantics.maximumReference: Unit-test-only bytearray straight-segment closure sweeps all four directions from the previous reached set for exactly three layers. This checks the four 1000x1000 extras without using the production interval-intersection oracle.

coverage: skinny maximum width/height, open and blocked
both HVH and VHV and reflected/transposed orientations
small randomized grids and all small-space obstacle masks
four full 1000x1000 open, disconnected, forced-two-turn and forced-three-turn grids

selectedWrongSourceMotivation.observation: Source inspection: intersects the start/end horizontal intervals and tests only vertical middle segments; it never checks VHV paths. The authored S** / ... / **T motif requires VHV.
selectedWrongSourceMotivation.scope: Suite motivation only; no public source execution or wrong-answer qualification claim.

selectedWrongSourceMotivation.observation: Source inspection: DFS visited is indexed only by cell, even though future reachability depends on arrival direction and used-turn budget. Exhaustive and randomized direction-state comparisons cover this class of defect.
selectedWrongSourceMotivation.scope: Suite motivation only; no public source execution or claimed algorithmic kill.

selectedWrongSourceMotivation.observation: Source inspection: globally marks every row/column containing an obstacle and rejects them as middle corridors, even for obstacles outside the actually used segment. The authored *S. / ... / .T* motif avoids those obstacles.
selectedWrongSourceMotivation.scope: Suite motivation only; capitalization, exceptions and presentation are not used as algorithmic evidence.
